title: The control-plane doc's minimum-records list describes unbuilt records and fields as shipped
outcome: The control-plane doc's minimum-records list describes unbuilt records and fields as shipped
acceptance: In docs/features/behavioral-control-plane.md's minimum-records list, ControlPolicy lists only its shipped fields (version and record id, project epoch, required assurance, supported effect classes, grant TTL, the selected obligation rule set, the acceptance-evaluation policy) and marks a classifier version, synchronization rules, degraded-envelope rules and a portable writer-validation maximum age as designed, not built

ParticipantRecord and SessionProgress are stated not to ship as named records, with what the shipped control_sessions row holds (asserted actor, durable phase, assurance and mediated effects, optional work-claim binding) and the role, expected contribution and join/leave state marked designed, not built

WorkClaim lists its shipped fields (holder, accepted work revision, expiry, revision, claim fence, state) without an assignment reference; WorkClaim and HandoffOffer are marked as shipped work records

ReportAssembly and ReportAssemblyClaim, PortableWriterState, and DegradedEnvelope and DegradedActionDebt are marked designed, not built; TurnGrant states its shipped state machine (issued to begun and completed, or to expired or superseded)

completion.summary:
Landed in 240e4c7 on master, together with w-3710fc2ca41c, w-1ad48d5ce497 and w-524b15d690c5.

The bcp minimum-records list now names only the fields that ship:

- ParticipantRecord/SessionProgress are described against the shipped control_sessions row.
- WorkClaim has its shipped fields, and WorkClaim and HandoffOffer are marked as shipped work records.
- ReportAssembly, PortableWriterState and Degraded* are marked designed, not built.
- TurnGrant states its state machine.
